mainEntity.name: What permits are required for a primary suite addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Primary suite additions typically require several permits, including building permits, electrical permits, plumbing permits, and mechanical permits. The specific requirements can vary based on your local jurisdiction. For instance, regulations in Alameda might differ slightly from those in Dublin. We handle all necessary permit applications and ensure that the project adheres to all local zoning ordinances and building codes before construction begins, streamlining the process for our clients.
